Seller pricing notes

Starting prices were set from used-market asks and new-retail anchors researched October 8, 2026. They assume the pictured condition; the drum price assumes it is fully functional.

Electronic drum kit — $550 list / $400 quick-sale floor

Current new-retail anchors were about $600–$799; used asks varied widely. Sources: Sweetwater, Alto Music, and a used listing.

Dresser with mirror — $250 list / $150 quick-sale floor

Comparable new traditional dresser-and-mirror sets were above $1,100, while local used asks vary greatly by condition and urgency. Sources: Bed Bath & Beyond and a moving-sale comp.

Nightstand + lamp — $95 list / $50 quick-sale floor

A comparable 3-drawer nightstand was around $300 new; the lamp adds a modest bundle value. Source: Sam's Furniture.

Bean bag set — $100 list / $40 quick-sale floor

Similar bean bags span roughly $60–$120 each new, but bulky local-pickup lots sell at a steep discount. Source: new-price reference.

Patio chair — $10 list / $3 quick-sale floor

The plastic chair is priced below typical new set cost. Source: chair set.
